topic: A homeowner discovers previous residents left items in the attic
text: I can't believe we've been digging through this attic and what do we find? Junk. Crumpled newspapers from who knows when, old, dusty board games missing pieces, and what’s this—a box of someone’s elementary school projects? This isn't just a few things left behind; it's a mess. I mean, how lazy can you be? And to think we’ve been dealing with all the repairs and renovations, only to find this at the end. Guess clearing this out is just another thing we have to do. Honestly, it’s like they didn’t even care if the next people had to deal with their garbage. Well, we’re cleaning it all up, and we’re doing it now.
